job_title: Scrape real estate listings from 3 Turkish property sites
draft: I'll scrape listings from sahibinden, emlakjet, and hepsiemlak using Playwright to bypass anti-bot measures, extracting address, price, m², rooms, photos, and agent contact into JSON and CSV. Fixed price: $230 (includes 15% buffer). Delivery: 5 days. Steps: 1) Analyze each site's structure and anti-bot defenses, 2) Build separate Playwright scrapers per site, 3) Implement rate limiting and proxy rotation, 4) Merge and deduplicate data, 5) Deliver validated JSON/CSV with sample verification.
